coverage: Super-repo git history restricted to scripts/substrate (591 of 5,473 commits, 2026-05-23 → 09-28), Dockerfile.substrate, scripts/git-hooks. Covered: add/delete cycles (--diff-filter A/D); full subject histories of substrate-pull-sync.sh, gen-env.sh, Makefile, self-recovery-tick.sh, setup-git-push.sh, apply-inventory.sh, entrypoint.sh, substrate-doctor.sh and the federation-relay files; full bodies of the key revert/prune/cleanup commits; git log -S on ~16 recurring identifiers; all 35 'Substrate Autonomous' super-repo commits; drift-commit commits in the in-container vessel clones (node 1). A caller scan for every non-compiled script (path-qualified, across scripts/.claude/.github/Dockerfile/units/packages/every repos/* tree, plus node-1 /etc/systemd and /usr/local/bin). Timer enablement and last result on both nodes. Read-only inspection of the host working-tree diff, the in-container super-repo clone status on both nodes, core.hooksPath and the git-push-setup journal. Summary only for repos/deployment (a gitignored helm/k8s clone, 1,014 commits, 03-28 → 06-25). Two existing 09-28 reports cross-read: MECHANISM-AUDIT and WHY-THINGS-KEEP-BREAKING. Skipped: per-commit diffs of most of the 591 commits; the content and output of each of the ~40 timer scripts (I did not check whether their outputs have readers); vessel-repo histories except the drift-commit family; no DB queries.

problems.symptom: Deploy convergence silently fails to ship a change type, restarts the wrong units, blocks on one vessel, or skips in silence
problems.root_cause: pull-sync is a 1,777-line shell script whose deploy unit is an allowlist of artefact types and a hand-maintained unit→source map. Each gap is found by an operator after the fact. Several parallel sync paths exist (pull-sync, mirror-to-live, runtime-drift repair, rhythm vessel-sync-and-health, cutovers)

problems.symptom: Autonomous commits sweep runtime state, scratch, compiled .js and cache binaries into git in the super-repo and vessel repos
problems.root_cause: The self-maintenance rhythm goal says 'commit and push' whatever the drift scan sees. Cleanups deleted its output but never changed the generator. The placement gate that should refuse root files is inert

problems.symptom: The placement gate is declared installed (09-23) but refuses nothing; root leases/ was committed 09-26
problems.root_cause: The causal-attempt-ledger set the system core.hooksPath to a hooks dir without a pre-commit, so git ignores .git/hooks/pre-commit. The inert-gate WARN is only logged (node 2); node 1 is silent

problems.symptom: The live image contains changes absent from origin/dev (ledger hooks installer and Dockerfile COPY); the host tree carries a large uncommitted Makefile regression
problems.root_cause: Images are built from the operator's dirty working tree, so a fresh build from the repo does not reproduce the running system (law 11)

problems.symptom: Node 2's super-repo clone is damaged (inventory truncated, script deleted) while pull-sync reports clean; DB watchdogs were enabled on a DB-less node; two inventories disagree
problems.root_cause: Per-node clones and state are mutated by unidentified writers; pull-sync ignores uncommitted work; unit enablement is not profile-aware; apply-inventory and self-fact-reconcile read different inventory files

problems.symptom: Detectors built, verified once, then never scheduled or never extended (identical-failure-run-tick, joint-liveness with one binding)
problems.root_cause: Nothing asserts that a built detector keeps firing with coverage. The one detector for the 'same failure, nothing changed' class was never given a unit

problems.symptom: Scripts become orphans when the lane that called them is deleted (Makefile targets 08-20, deploy lanes 09-23); deprecated shims and temporary conduits persist
problems.root_cause: The retention rule runs as occasional operator prunes (08-02, 08-05), not as a continuous check; deletions do not follow the dependents of what they delete

problems.symptom: Behaviour knobs (MITOSIS_DIRECT_PUSH, TRACE_RETENTION_*, RUNTIME_DRIFT_REPAIR, CUTOVER_LEASE_WAIT_MS, ENABLED/DISABLED_VESSELS) live in gen-env and unit Environment; the env bus itself repeatedly loses or corrupts values
problems.root_cause: A new behaviour gets an env var instead of a shaped impulse. The 1,801-line gen-env has quoting, heredoc and carry-through defects that no instrument sees

problems.symptom: Operator fixes to fleet-wide deployment files regress other hosts or mechanisms (DB OOM, arms disabled, deploy loop wedged, placement gate disabled)
problems.root_cause: Changes are validated on one host or against their own motivating check. Shared unit and env files deploy to heterogeneous hosts via pull-sync with no cross-host or cross-mechanism check

problems.symptom: Phantom relay reservations and one-directional partitions recur; the federation oracle's own checks were vacuous or self-destructive
problems.root_cause: The transport is a scripts-hosted vessel outside the submodule authoring loop, and each fix targets the observed instance

problems.symptom: The self-recovery immune system restarts things that are healthy, starting, or under DB pressure (autoimmune)
problems.root_cause: Restart policy uses health probes that cannot tell a wedged vessel from a busy one; it was patched per incident

problems.symptom: Setup docs and Makefile targets claim behaviour that does not happen (silent .PHONY success, build-from-source did not build, false prerequisites)
problems.root_cause: Docs were verified by reading, not execution. The acceptance harness (09-23) exists but its end-to-end run on a published digest is still pending

problems.symptom: Untracked residue accumulates in in-container clones: 1,629 entries on node 1, including literal {{target_path}}/{{out_path}} files and 1,552 failure-mode scenarios
problems.root_cause: Walks, tests and LLM tool steps write with cwd or paths inside the super-repo clone. Unrendered template bindings are used as file paths. The drift-commit family later commits them

principles: A gate with no call sites can never be observed failing, so it can never be trusted when it passes (8d3e57ce 08-02; CLAUDE.md script retention)
Two copies is the producer/consumer drift this tree keeps paying for (008f3ab9 08-20)
A truncated search is not an absence (bb217e5e 09-13)
A timer that never runs emits silence, and silence reads as health; an active timer proves scheduling, not work (7f97df70, 6452ee6f)
A cap is a property of the HOST; lowering a live cap is not a safe edit (9df01220 08-17)
Cheap per statement is not cheap in aggregate (07e32d38 08-16)
A static scanner belongs as a graded resolver, not a host timer script — law 2 applies to scripts (807b92ef 09-28)
A file the substrate rewrites is not a file git should carry (CLAUDE.md placement; f90dda1a)
Fail LOUD on your own input, QUIET on gap emission (a172e235)
A hold's lift condition names the generator, not the instance (09-28 14:50 drift-commit hold)
A container-wide core.hooksPath without a chaining pre-commit leaves the gate inert (CLAUDE.md; confirmed live 09-29)
